feed_summary: Tailscale has released version 1.104.4 to fix flaws in its built-in SSH server that could let an attacker reach services and files on other servers that only the root user should be able to touch. title: Tailscale Patches SSH Flaws That Could Let Hacked Devices Gain Root Access on Other Servers
